credential-in-shell-args.notes: Caught CRITICAL C1 — mysqldump -p flag DB password exposure in ps. Harness confirmed clean in 2nd run.

type-mismatch-string-vs-int.notes: Caught CRITICAL C2 — http_code() str vs int comparison always False

shared-library-init-config.notes: Systemic: config loading in __init__ guarantees all consumers get it

importlib-for-cli-tools.notes: 13 silent SKIPS became 13 PASSes. Harness confirmed clean in 2nd run.

user-input-shell-validation.notes: Fired 3rd time: wp-forensics.py grep pattern unquoted — same bug missed first pass (harness only checked scan/audit). Fixed 2026-06-19.

shell-expansion-breaks-regex.notes: repr() variant: same root cause (shell-expanding regex patterns). Fixed 2026-06-19 with shlex.quote. 2nd run harness clean.

posix-sh-single-quote-semantics.notes: Fired 2nd time 2026-06-19: same backslash-doubling pattern suggested as fix, caught before landing. POSIX sh single-quotes are fully literal — no backslash special meaning inside them.

response-type-validation.notes: REST API heuristic ('slug' in body) fired on error JSON dict, causing AttributeError on str.get(). Fix: isinstance(parsed, list) before loop.

secret-derivation-for-output.notes: NEW 2026-06-19: Raw WP_ARSENAL_HONEYPOT_SECRET in every page HTML href/JS. Fix: hash_hmac('sha256', floor(time()/3600), SECRET). Secrets must never appear in client-visible output — always derive a one-way token.

resource-lifecycle-management.notes: NEW 2026-06-19: paramiko.SFTPClient.from_transport() in loop leaked channels. Fix: wp._get_sftp() (lifecycle-managed). Pattern: always use framework-provided resource accessors, never raw library constructors that bypass lifecycle management.

tmp-file-permissions.notes: NEW 2026-06-19: /tmp evidence dir world-readable on shared hosting. Fix: mkdir && chmod 700 in same ssh() call. Archive: tar && chmod 600. Rule: any /tmp directory creation must be followed immediately by chmod 700.

operator-config-trust-boundary.notes: NEW 2026-06-19 (from grill-me): wp.* vars (wp_path, db_pass, etc.) are trusted operator config. If any is ever sourced from untrusted external input (webhooks, API), validate with sql_slug() or shlex.quote() at the boundary. Document trust model in any new script that accepts external input.

check-ssh-fstring-injection.sh.notes: Non-blocking audit aid. 13 wp.* f-string calls flagged — all use operator config (trusted). Real injection in http_body caught by code-review not harness.

check-secret-in-html.sh.notes: NEW 2026-06-19. 1st run PASS — fix already applied (HMAC token). Retroactively would have caught honeypot.php raw secret.

check-sftp-from-transport.sh.notes: NEW 2026-06-19. 1st run PASS — fix already applied (_get_sftp). Retroactively would have caught wp-backup.py from_transport.
